question: ap1
constraint: with only a single time point measured per sample
prompt:
Constraint: every one of your ideas must be carried out with only a single time point measured per sample. Within that constraint, make the ideas as informative as possible.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Chromatin persistence at AP-1 enhancers after signal washout
ideas.description: Give a transient stimulus, then harvest separate animal or cell cohorts at different washout intervals, each sampled once by ATAC-seq or CUT&Tag for H3K27ac and AP-1 (Fos/Jun) occupancy. If AP-1-bound enhancers stay open or acetylated after c-Fos/JunB protein returns to baseline, that supports a chromatin-based memory rather than a transient signaling response.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome linking prior exposure to a later response
ideas.description: Split a population into groups with different prior AP-1-activating histories, then challenge each group with a standard stimulus and collect one multiome snapshot per sample at the response peak. Test whether residual AP-1 motif accessibility before the challenge predicts the magnitude and speed of the secondary target-gene induction, and whether that predictive signal is absent in cells lacking the pre-exposure.

ideas.title: Necessity test with AP-1 loss-of-function in a persistence readout
ideas.description: Compare the persistent chromatin and transcriptional state at a single late timepoint in wild-type cells versus cells with Fos or Jun knockdown, dominant-negative A-FOS/TAM67 expression, or conditional deletion, each sampled once after the same stimulus history. If the persistent enhancer marks or memory-associated gene expression disappear without AP-1, AP-1 is required rather than merely correlated with memory.

ideas.title: Decoupling AP-1 protein decay from chromatin memory
ideas.description: Use mass cytometry or phospho/intracellular flow to measure c-Fos, JunB and other AP-1 protein levels in single cells across a series of washout durations, with each cell measured once. A mismatch in which AP-1 protein returns to baseline while chromatin marks or target-gene poised states remain elevated would separate a durable mnemonic state from ongoing AP-1 signaling.

ideas.title: Ex vivo re-stimulation of explants harvested after in vivo experience
ideas.description: Expose animals to a single in vivo stimulus, then at a fixed later time harvest tissue explants and stimulate each one ex vivo with the same challenge, fixing each explant once for AP-1 target-gene and AP-1 motif-enhancer readouts. Explants from experienced animals that show faster or stronger AP-1 target induction than naive controls would indicate a latent, cell-intrinsic memory that survives tissue removal from the original context.
